description: Codema, Dublin’s energy agency, publishes a 2021 list of Dublin electricity-substation names. Zenodo provides a public Excel workbook under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The deposit says it combines stations in a 2017 distribution-capacity enquiry with names supplied by ESB on request. This list can help reconcile named substations across maps, capacity records and network-simulation inputs. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Dublin name table. A limitation is that the public description does not state whether the workbook includes coordinates, voltages, operator identifiers or a complete inventory of every station. The two source vintages also differ, so names may have changed by 2021 or since. This is a reference list, not a verified electrical topology or capacity model. The XLSX was not downloaded, and row count and spelling were not independently checked.
